content.comment_body: Hello, I followed your instructions to send the stopwatch time from my project to the web editor page. Everything works well, and I can see the time displayed online. However, is it possible to keep the time even after a power failure? I am aware the saved time will be lost if I upload a new program, but I am hoping to retain it in case of power loss. Would appreciate any guidance. Best regards, [user_name]

Closed because this question was posted twice. The other thread titled 'Remember hours counter' related to [product_name] and [product_name] V[version_no] is posted in the appropriate project section. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are able to display stopwatch values on a web interface using [company_name] solutions but are concerned about losing these values after a power outage. While they accept losing such data due to program uploads, their main challenge is maintaining non-volatile storage of operational time or counter values through power cycles.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to support persistent value storage for items like stopwatch time, so data can withstand power interruptions (excluding reprogramming scenarios).
pain_keywords: loss of data after power outage
